NewsArticle.Title: Registration Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: Registration site will be offline for up to 4 hours during registration maintenance; the exact time is unpredictable. At that time no registration changes may be processed. Thank you for your patience. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
